title: Too soon?  Probably 😅. Will I probably change my mind a million times...
transcript: The Tony Award nominations just came out today, but it is never too early to start predicting who is gonna win. here are my early initial thoughts on who I think The Front Runner is in every single category, starting with best play, I think it's liberation all the way. It just won the Pulitzer. It's gonna ride that momentum all the way to a Tony win. Best musical truly could go any which way, but right now I'm kind of leaning schmigadoon. For Best Revival of a play, it's probably death of a salesman, but in my heart, it's Becky Shaw. Best Revival of a musical, I think it's cats all the way. For lead actor in a musical, it is 100% Josh Henry's to lose. For lead Actress in a musical, I'm going Casey Levy, although I'm kind of rooting for a Sarah Chase upset. I don't know. Lead actor in a play, I think it's Lithgow or Lane. I'm leaning Lithgow, but it could go either way. Lead actress in a play. I'm really hoping for Susannah Flood in Liberation. Book of a musical, I kind of think it's gonna be a rogue to strangers win. And then for original score, I think it's gonna be schmigadoon. Scenic design of a play, I think it's gonna be Chloe Lamford for death of a salesman. For scenic design of a musical, I controversially have Scott Pask. For schmigadoon. I think that the hand painted sets are gonna Push it over the edge! But don't worry, Lost Boys fans, your wins are coming. Costume design of a play, I think it's Paul Tazewell for Joe Turner's come and gone. Costume design of a musical, I think it's Queen Jean. For cats the jockey ball, lighting design of a play, I think will be Jack Knowles for death of a salesman. Lighting design of a musical, I think will be Jen Schriever and Michael Arden for The Lost Boys. For sound design of a play, I think it will be Michaela Sulaiman. For death of a salesman, sound design of a musical, I'm gonna go Kai Harada. For cats the Musical Ball, direction of a play, I'm going Joe Mantello for death of a salesman, but in my heart, it's Whitney White. For Liberation, Best Direction of a musical, I'm going Jalen Levingston and Bill Rosh for cats the Musical Ball. And for Best Choreography, I'm going with Omari Willis and Archer O'leary for cats the Musical Ball. Best orchestrations, I'm going with Andrew Lloyd Webber, David Wilson, Trevor Holder, and Doug Shat for cats the Jockey Ball. And then for the featured acting categories for featured actress in a play, I'm going Betsy Adams in Liberation. Featured actor in a play, I'm going with Ruben Santiago Hudson for Joe Turner's Coming Gone. Featured actress in a musical, I'm going with Shoshana Bean for The Lost Boys. And finally, for featured actor in a musical, I'm going Andre De Shields for cats the Musical Ball
